title: Google Knowledge Catalog - AI agent ko company ka context
content:
AI agent galat answer kyun deta hai?
Most of the time, the model is fine. The context is missing.
Kal Google Cloud ne apne Knowledge Catalog mein ek naya feature launch kiya, self-learning context enrichment.
Ye abhi preview mein hai, aur Google ke mutabik next few weeks mein customers tak rollout hoga.
Pehle samjho, context kya hota hai.
Maan lo aap agent se poochte ho, "last month ka active customer count batao."
Ab aapki company mein active customer ka matlab kya hai? Thirty days mein login? Ya paid plan?
The model does not know your company's definitions. Aur yahin galti hoti hai.
Google ka naya feature agent aur users ki baatcheet ko analyze karta hai.
Jahan context missing ya outdated hai, wo gap pakadta hai.
Phir playbooks, code repositories aur business documents se verified definitions uthata hai.
And a human can review those changes in Knowledge Studio before they go live.
Ab numbers dekho. Google kehta hai ki Knowledge Catalog agents ko nearly four times more accurate banata hai.
Up to thirty three percent lower latency, aur up to seventy five percent kam tokens.
Ye Google ke internal benchmarks hain, independent test nahi.
Par yahan twist hai. Ye idea aap bina Google ke bhi use kar sakte ho.
Step ONE. Apni company ke important terms ki ek simple glossary banao, aur agent ko har baar wo do.
Step TWO. Jab bhi agent galat answer de, use log karo.
Step THREE. Har hafte un logs se glossary update karo.
That is a manual version of the same feedback loop.
Mera take simple hai... aane wale time mein sabse valuable skill prompt likhna nahi, sahi context dena hogi.
Google ne khud likha hai, context engineers. That is a real role now.
Google ka blog chahiye? Comment CONTEXT and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
